english.note: Use this for emotional closure when someone needs an explanation, resolution, or sense that an unresolved matter has been accounted for.

exampleSentences.english: They finally explained everything, so I got closure.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢終於肯解釋件事，我先至有一個交代。
